cases.sentence: Он взял шестьсот ___ и все остальные колесницы Египта с их начальниками.
cases.explain: «отборных колесниц» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: and he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, with captains over all of them.

cases.sentence: Он взял шестьсот отборных колесниц и все ___ Египта с их начальниками.
cases.explain: «остальные колесницы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: and he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, with captains over all of them.

cases.sentence: Ангел Бога, Который шел перед ___, пошел позади него.
cases.explain: «израильским войском» — after the preposition «перед», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: The angel of God, who went before the camp of Israel, moved and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud moved from before them, and stood behind them.

cases.sentence: ___ тоже передвинулся со своего места и оказался позади них, 20 между войсками Египта и Израиля.
cases.explain: «Облачный столб» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The angel of God, who went before the camp of Israel, moved and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud moved from before them, and stood behind them.

cases.sentence: Моисей простер руку над морем, а Господь всю ночь отгонял море сильным ___ и превратил его в сушу.
cases.explain: «восточным ветром» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and Yahweh caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.

cases.sentence: Перед ___ Господь посмотрел из огненного и облачного столба на египетское войско и поверг его в смятение.
cases.explain: «самым рассветом» — after the preposition «перед», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: In the morning watch, Yahweh looked out on the Egyptian army through the pillar of fire and of cloud, and confused the Egyptian army.
